About the Platform

A Consultation Platform
Built on Real Experience

SELECT is not a coaching factory. It is an independent consultation service designed to help individuals understand what selection panels actually look for — and then close that gap with precision.

Sessions are built around the candidate's specific target: UPSC, a campus placement, an MBA admit, a corporate role, or a research fellowship. Every session is structured, feedback-driven, and grounded in the mentor's direct experience across business, data, strategy, and research.

SELECT operates on three principles: clarity over noise, structure over guesswork, and professional standards in every interaction.

How It Works

Four Steps from Register to Session

The entire process — including payment verification — is automatic. No chasing, no waiting.

I

Register Interest

Fill the short interest form. Takes under 90 seconds. No commitment required at this stage.

II

Receive Your Link

Your exclusive, token-secured booking link arrives in your inbox within minutes of registering.

III

Book & Pay

Choose your slot from the live calendar, pay ₹600 via UPI, enter your UTR — payment is verified automatically.

IV

Session & Debrief

Your Google Meet link arrives instantly. 60-minute session followed by written feedback and 48-hour Q&A access.
